e135: pin ↔ axle-hole is not a compatible pair
notes: The booklet has three models from one set. Racer X car is b1-b111, the truck cab (Cruncher Block) is b112-b249, and the trailer is b250-b353. The sticker sheet b111 is one node, joined to the parts it decorates.
Every one of the 353 listed pieces is a node, with ids assigned in rough build order. Minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, helmet) are not in the official parts list, so they are not nodes.

Counts match the inventory line for line. Where the pictures were too small to tell which model a piece belongs to, I assigned it by plausibility. The 4x 6141 black round plates are placed on the truck and the black 3795 2x6 plate is placed in the trailer's aquarium base.
Plain stud/anti-stud joins use null ports because the exact stud positions are not legible in the small step pictures. Pin, axle, clip, hinge and bar joins use named ports where they are clear.

Some attachments, mostly 1-2 pieces per sub-assembly, are placed on the most plausible host piece rather than a verified stud position. Examples are the wheel arches, yellow tiles and plates, the red 1x6 and 1x4 roof plates, and the black 3623 plates in the truck cab.

Wheel, tyre and wheel-cover pieces have no ports in the catalogue, so they are joined to their hubs with null ports. The 56145 wheels sit on 3941 round-brick hubs on the 3737 axles. The 55982 car wheels sit directly on the 3707 axles with 32123b bushes.

The trailer's kingpin assembly (b336-b339) points out from the trailer underside, but the manual shows no explicit connection to the truck. No truck-to-trailer edge is added because the hitch is not part of the build steps.
